mapper.select: SELECT DATE(created_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE(created_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE(created_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orders, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders WHERE order_status = 1 AND created_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE(created_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT b.id AS book_id, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, SUM(oi.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.price) AS amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN books b ON b.id = oi.book_id WHERE o.order_status = 1 AND o.created_time >= #{start} GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT order_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE created_time >= #{start} GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_status
